name: Sung Kook 'Bill' Hwang

summary.text: Sung Kook 'Bill' Hwang founded and ran Archegos Capital Management, a family office whose concentrated, swap-financed equity positions collapsed in March 2021, causing large losses at prime brokers including Credit Suisse. In July 2024 a federal jury in Manhattan convicted him of racketeering conspiracy, securities fraud, market manipulation and wire fraud after a nine-week trial; in November 2024 Judge Alvin Hellerstein sentenced him to 18 years in prison, three years of supervised release and more than $9 billion in restitution. Archegos's chief financial officer Patrick Halligan was a codefendant.

openQuestions: Site claim that Hwang was 'convicted of federal racketeering and market manipulation': supported (SDNY release).
Site claim that Halligan was 'convicted alongside Hwang': the SDNY release names him as codefendant; his verdict and sentence were not confirmed from the text returned.
Site claims about the March 25, 2021 prime-broker meeting, Morgan Stanley's $5 billion sale and Goldman's early block sales were not tested here.
